Root Cause: Assumed resting limit orders fill with 100% certainty when bar low/high touches limit price.
Historical Impact: Overestimated limit fill rates by ignoring queue position, queue depletion, and order replacement latency.

Remaining Risk: Heuristics remain uncalibrated to empirical Level 2 order-book queue survival curves.

Remaining Risk: Directional bias risks regime-shift vulnerability during macro bear drawdowns.

Remaining Risk: Requires dynamic volatility scaling rather than static historical quantiles.

Remaining Risk: Researchers must never cite statistical ROC-AUC as proof of economic alpha.
